title: Charges and reimbursement
subtitle: What the client charged to receive the load, checked here and billed to the contractor who hired the freight.

batch.hint: The batch belongs to the contractor and the period — never to the trip. One trip mixes contractors, and each gets their own batch.
batch.linkHint: The contractor's approval link is generated when the batch is closed and lives on the public page. Closing the period again issues a new link, and the old one stops working.
batch.title: Close the contractor period

errors.DELIVERY_CHARGE_AMOUNT_REQUIRED: This suggestion came from the driver without an amount. Fill in the receipt amount before confirming.
errors.EXTRA_CHARGE_BATCH_EMPTY: There is no checked charge for this contractor in this period.

reimbursements.title: Reimbursements
reimbursements.subtitle: Occurrence charges still without a batch — mark the rows that enter the next statement.
reimbursements.forbidden: This screen requires the trip financials permission.
reimbursements.empty: No occurrence charge open for this filter.

table.selectAll: Select all charges on the page

close.hint: Closing uses the date range that covers the marked rows — but it takes **all** unbatched charges of this contractor within that period, not only the marked ones. Check the range before closing.
close.emptyError: Mark at least one row before closing.
close.mixedContractorError: The marked rows belong to different contractors — close one contractor at a time.
close.missingContractorError: One of the marked rows has no identified contractor.

statement.hint: The statement belongs to the batch that just closed. Sending it to the contractor is a person's call — this screen never sends anything on its own.

queue.hint: The recurring rule and the driver's report propose; a person confirms. The amount is editable right here.
queue.missingAmount: A selected suggestion has no amount. Fill it in before confirming.
queue.title: Suggestions to review ({{count}})
